title: Correctional Officers and Jailers
description: Guard inmates in penal or rehabilitative institutions in accordance with established regulations and procedures. May guard prisoners in transit between jail, courtroom, prison, or other point. Includes deputy sheriffs and police who spend the majority of their time guarding prisoners in correctional institutions.

tasks.text: Conduct head counts to ensure that each prisoner is present.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical counting of bodies in a facility

tasks.text: Inspect conditions of locks, window bars, grills, doors, and gates at correctional facilities to ensure security and help prevent escapes.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on safety inspection of physical equipment

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.

tasks.text: Monitor conduct of prisoners in housing unit, or during work or recreational activities, according to established policies, regulations, and procedures, to prevent escape or violence.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can watch camera feeds; human maintains physical surveillance

dwas.name: Maintain surveillance of individuals or establishments.

tasks.text: Search prisoners and vehicles and conduct shakedowns of cells for valuables and contraband, such as weapons or drugs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Spotting suspicious objects needs physical visual search

dwas.name: Search individuals for illegal or dangerous items.

tasks.text: Guard facility entrances to screen visitors.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical guarding of facilities

tasks.text: Record information, such as prisoner identification, charges, and incidents of inmate disturbance, keeping daily logs of prisoner activities.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Suspect records drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Record information about suspects or criminals.

tasks.text: Inspect mail for the presence of contraband.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo hazard inspection requires on-site presence

dwas.name: Inspect cargo to identify potential hazards.

tasks.text: Maintain records of prisoners' identification and charges.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Suspect records drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Record information about suspects or criminals.

tasks.text: Use weapons, handcuffs, and physical force to maintain discipline and order among prisoners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical force and weapons in unpredictable confrontations

dwas.name: Use weapons or physical force to maintain security.

tasks.text: Use nondisciplinary tools and equipment, such as a computer.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating systems requires hands-on interaction

tasks.text: Conduct fire, safety, and sanitation inspections.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical fire-code walkthrough requires presence and judgment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with fire regulations.
Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with security or safety regulations.

tasks.text: Take prisoners into custody and escort to locations within and outside of facility, such as visiting room, courtroom, or airport.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical custody and escort of prisoners

dwas.name: Escort prisoners to courtrooms, prisons, or other facilities.

tasks.text: Participate in required job training.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Attending training is a physical, human presence act

dwas.name: Attend training to learn new skills or update knowledge.

tasks.text: Serve meals, distribute commissary items, and dispense prescribed medication to prisoners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering meds/injections requires hands-on clinical action

tasks.text: Settle disputes between inmates.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live conflict resolution needs presence and trust

dwas.name: Resolve interpersonal conflicts.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Provide to supervisors oral and written reports of the quality and quantity of work performed by inmates, inmate disturbances and rule violations, and unusual occurrences.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Performance and complaint discussions carry accountability

dwas.name: Discuss performance, complaints, or violations with supervisors.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Drive passenger vehicles and trucks used to transport inmates to other institutions, courtrooms, hospitals, and work sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles to transport people/equipment

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport individuals or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Counsel inmates and respond to legitimate questions, concerns, and requests.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Interpersonal counseling needs human relationship

dwas.name: Provide counsel, comfort, or encouragement to individuals or families.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

dwas.name: Counsel clients regarding interpersonal issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Assign duties to inmates, providing instructions as needed.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Inmate supervision is physical, situated, accountability-bearing

tasks.text: Issue clothing, tools, and other authorized items to inmates.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Arrange daily schedules for prisoners, including library visits, work assignments, family visits, and counseling appointments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routine schedule generation from stated constraints

dwas.name: Prepare activity or work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Search for and recapture escapees.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically apprehending suspects

tasks.text: Process or book convicted individuals into prison.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Suspect records drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Record information about suspects or criminals.

tasks.text: Supervise and coordinate work of other correctional service officers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Correctional facility direction is high-stakes human authority

tasks.text: Take fingerprints of arrestees, prisoners, or the general public.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Client info gathering needs human relationship and trust

tasks.text: Investigate crimes that have occurred within an institution, or assist police in their investigations of crimes and inmates.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids analysis, investigation is human-led

tasks.text: Sponsor inmate recreational activities, such as newspapers and self-help groups.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Inmate supervision is physical, situated, accountability-bearing

emerging_tasks.task: Conduct security checks of the premises.
